name: Muhammad Ganjar Imanudin
title: Back-End Developer
headline: .NET · MongoDB · PostgreSQL
summaryBio: Software developer with 5+ years of experience building scalable web applications, focused on back-end development and always eager to keep growing my back-end skills.

skills.note: Used for repetitive and boilerplate code, and as an assistant to cross-check requirement docs, designs and the actual code. All generated code goes through my own review to meet the project's criteria and quality standards.

descJob: Developed the back-end for RIFTSTORM, a co-op PvE looter-shooter on Steam, using .NET 8 in a team of 3 programmers and collaborating with 10+ roles across the game project.
Implemented player-related data models (e.g., Player Inventory) and persisted them in MongoDB for scalable and structured storage.
Researched, tested, and implemented MongoDB Sharding to support distributed multi-region data, ensuring optimal data locality and performance.
Refactored and enhanced Hangfire job system, introducing job tagging and account-based filtering for improved traceability and debugging.
Reduced background job load on the main back-end by modularizing Hangfire into a standalone project, improving scalability and configuration flexibility.
Integrated Sentry for application monitoring, utilizing custom issue and transaction tagging to enable faster and more accurate diagnostics.
Delivered a production-ready game server capable of supporting 1,000+ players during Steam Next Fest in June 2025.
Built CI/CD pipelines to containerize the server app and generate compose scripts, enabling game programmers to test back-end integration independently.
Worked on multiple projects for clients across different sectors.
Focused on integrating with external systems and providing data to the front-end.
Worked primarily with .NET 8, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL.
Developed the front-end admin dashboard and back-end systems for gamified learning apps using Ruby on Rails in a team of 5 developers.
Developed REST APIs for communication between the back-end and front-end using Grape (a Ruby API framework).
Designed and developed an admin dashboard for a city government using Phalcon and Bootstrap.
Designed and developed a mobile version of the admin dashboard for Android using WebView.

portfolio.title: RIFTSTORM
